free_tier.stated: 10 GB of file storage for the whole workspace on Free

egress.terms: Free; files served from Pumble's own CDN

tooling: No public file API documented; web/desktop clients only. Wrapper would have to be scraped.
chaining: Workspaces include 10 GB storage each with no documented automated deletion policy. Multiple free workspaces can be registered independently.
limits_note: 10 GB workspace total; storage counts uploads across channels, DMs and meeting recordings; at the limit you must delete files before uploading more
reliability_note: No documented retention deletion (unlike Slack), but no API either, so it is manual-only.

evidence.proved: table: 'Free plan | 10GB storage for the whole workspace'; 'Pro plan | 10GB storage per user seat'
Pumble's first-party help page still states 10 GB of file storage for the whole workspace on the free plan
evidence.quote: The free plan includes 10 GB for the entire Workspace. Pro gives 10 GB per user seat, Business 20 GB per seat, and Enterprise 100 GB per seat.

evidence.proved: at the storage limit the user must delete previously uploaded files before uploading more
evidence.quote: If it reaches the limit, you'll need to delete some of the previously uploaded files to upload new ones.

notes: 10 GB of file storage for the whole workspace on Free
